entity.name: Abhinav Srivastav
entity.description:
I'm a BSc IT student based in Mumbai, India, and an independent contributor to the Rust compiler and toolchain. I've been contributing to rust-lang/rust since December 2025, with 20 merged pull requests across whole rust-lang covering reproducible builds, bootstrap, compiler fixes and regression tests. I've also contributed to the cc-rs project.

My contributions are public: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Aparadoxicalguy

I intend to continue working on compiler correctness, reproducibility and related tooling, including investigating bugs, preparing fixes and contributing regression tests upstream.

projects.name: My contributions to the Rust compiler
projects.description:
My individual contributions to rust-lang/rust, submitted upstream as pull requests. This is a personal contribution record, not a project I represent. All PRs: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Aparadoxicalguy

Milestone work.
Month 3: Land active PRs including https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157914 (reproducible compiler-builtins archives on Windows), https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/165202 (deterministic rlib object names), https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/165006 (Reborrow impls on types with &'static mut fields), https://github.com/rust-lang/ar_archive_writer/pull/40, and a companion regression test PR for the MSVC byte-count and LTO fix.
Month 6: Ongoing triage and fixes for compiler crashes (ICEs) and reproducibility issues in rustc, expanding test coverage in tests/ui, and publishing a public technical write-up.

plans.name: Rust Compiler & Reproducibility Fellowship
plans.description: Fellowship supporting ongoing upstream contributions to rust-lang/rust and toolchain components. Work over 6 months covers resolving open reproducibility and compiler PRs on Windows/MSVC and Linux, landing upstream regression tests, and a public technical write-up as detailed in the project milestones. One-time grant of INR 100,000 upfront to support ongoing contributor capacity.
